luck: 10 rules tried here (one version each) from a sweep of ~30 sources; the library holds ~590 ideas. Read block t against the proof bar, not 2.5. Value, quality and payout baskets overlap (cheap, profitable large caps): their results are not independent.
standard: both halves (entry review before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2% cost, better than the average liquid stock bought and sold at the same moments (rule and yardstick capped at +300%, AUD-1), better than the same stock held as long on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5, return per year of capital tied up above SPY on the same days -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.1 -> PROVEN. Baskets also as one account (0.4% per side) vs SPY and SPUS per half (gates scan.mjs).

SQ16-MAGIC.name: Greenblatt magic formula (EBIT/EV + return on capital, 1000 largest, 10 a quarter, each held a year)
SQ16-MAGIC.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 1000 largest, financials and utilities out. Earnings yield = EBIT / EV (EV > 0); return on capital = EBIT / (net working capital + net fixed assets), net working capital = (current assets - cash) - (current liabilities - current debt) floored at 0, net fixed assets = net property, plant and equipment; EBIT > 0 and capital > 0 needed. Rank each (1 = best), add the ranks, lowest sum first (ties: higher earnings yield). Each review buys the 10 best-ranked not held in the three younger sleeves; each sleeve is held one year (sold at the next open after the review four quarters later unless re-picked). About 40 holdings.
SQ16-MAGIC.deviations: EBIT = operating income (no add-backs); a quarterly sleeve of 10 instead of "5-7 every 2-3 months"; market-value universe instead of the site's 50M+ screen (the book's 1000-largest version).

SQ16-ACQM.name: Carlisle Acquirer's Multiple (30 cheapest by EV / EBIT among the 1000 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-ACQM.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 1000 largest, financials and utilities out. Acquirer's multiple = EV / EBIT with EBIT > 0 and EV > 0. Hold the 30 with the lowest multiple (ties: larger EBIT first), equal weight; sold when no longer among the 30 at a review.
SQ16-ACQM.deviations: EBIT = operating income (Carlisle's "operating earnings" adds back depreciation details); equal weight (the paper value-weights with a cap); 30 names (the site's screens show 30).

SQ16-QVAL.name: Gray & Carlisle Quantitative Value (cheapest 10% by EV/EBIT, then the better half by Piotroski F-score, quarterly)
SQ16-QVAL.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 1000 largest, financials, utilities and REITs (SIC 6798, inside financials) out. Keep the cheapest 10% (ceil) by EV / EBIT among those with EBIT > 0 and EV > 0; of them hold the better half (ceil) by Piotroski F-score (9 tests, each 1 point: net income > 0; operating cash flow > 0; net income / assets up vs a year earlier; operating cash flow > net income; long-term debt / assets down; current ratio up; no common stock issued (TTM proceeds 0 or missing); gross margin up; revenue / assets up; 6+ of the 9 must be computable, a test that cannot be computed scores 0); ties: cheaper first. Equal weight; sold when no longer selected.
SQ16-QVAL.deviations: Quality = the F-score only (the book adds franchise power: 8-year ROA / margin stability, not available on a 5-year window); EBIT = operating income; universe = 1000 largest (QVAL: top 60% of NYSE by size).

SQ16-GPVAL.name: Novy-Marx profitable value (gross profit / assets rank + book / market rank, 50 of the 500 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-GPVAL.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 500 largest, financials out. GP/A = TTM gross profit (or revenue - cost of revenue) / latest total assets; B/M = latest stockholders' equity / market value; both known and equity > 0. Score = percentile rank of GP/A + percentile rank of B/M (each 0..1 within the eligible set); hold the 50 highest (ties: higher GP/A), equal weight; sold when no longer among the 50.
SQ16-GPVAL.deviations: Long only (the paper is long-short); quarterly instead of annual / monthly; a fixed 50 instead of the top tercile / decile.

SQ16-MSCIQ.name: MSCI USA Quality method (iShares QUAL): ROE, low debt, stable earnings; 125 of the 600 largest, May/November, index-weighted
SQ16-MSCIQ.rule: Reviews at the last session of May and November. Universe: the 600 largest. ROE = TTM net income / latest stockholders' equity (equity > 0; required); D/E = debt / equity; earnings variability = standard deviation of the year-on-year growth of annual net income ((NI_y - NI_y-1) / |NI_y-1|) over up to the last 5 fiscal years filed before the review (3+ growth values). Each variable winsorised at its 5th / 95th percentile, z-scored; D/E and variability negated; composite = the average of the available z (ROE + at least one other); quality score = 1 + z when z >= 0, 1 / (1 - z) when z < 0. Select the 125 best composites; a current holding stays while it ranks in the best 150 (MSCI's 20% buffer), the rest filled from the top. Per trade equal weight; in the PORTFOLIO each new holding gets its index weight (quality score x market value, normalised over the 125, capped at 5%).
SQ16-MSCIQ.deviations: Net income instead of EPS (no per-share history needed); debt = squad5 debtCashAt; 125 is MSCI USA Quality's usual count (fixed number set at launch); 600 largest = MSCI USA proxy; weights fixed at entry, not re-set at each review.

SQ16-SHYLD.name: Meb Faber shareholder yield (dividends + net buybacks + debt paydown, top 100 of the 1000 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-SHYLD.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 1000 largest, financials out. Shareholder yield = (TTM dividends paid + TTM common stock repurchased - TTM common stock issued) / market value + (debt a year earlier - debt now) / market value (debt paydown; 0 when either debt is unknown); dividends / repurchases / issuance missing = 0; at least one of dividends or repurchases must be reported. Hold the 100 highest (ties: larger market value), equal weight; sold when no longer among the 100.
SQ16-SHYLD.deviations: No value / quality composite (SYLD adds them after the yield rank); 1000 largest instead of SYLD's size floor.

SQ16-VALMOM.name: AQR value + momentum combined (book/market rank + 12-1 momentum rank, 100 of the 1000 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-VALMOM.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 1000 largest (all sectors). Value = latest stockholders' equity / market value (equity > 0); momentum = close 21 sessions before / close 252 sessions before - 1. Score = percentile rank of value + percentile rank of momentum (each 0..1 among stocks with both); hold the 100 highest (ties: higher momentum), equal weight; sold when no longer among the 100.
SQ16-VALMOM.deviations: Long only, quarterly (the paper is long-short, monthly, rank-weighted).

SQ16-CORNER.name: O'Shaughnessy Cornerstone Growth (price/sales < 1.5, earnings up, top by 12-month price strength; each held a year)
SQ16-CORNER.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 1000 largest (all sectors). Eligible: price / sales = market value / TTM revenue < 1.5; TTM net income above the TTM net income a year earlier; 12-month price change (close / close 252 sessions before - 1) known. Rank by the 12-month price change (highest first). Each review buys the 13 best-ranked not held in the three younger sleeves (about 50 held, his number); each sleeve is held one year (sold at the next open after the review four quarters later unless re-picked).
SQ16-CORNER.deviations: Annual rebalance spread over 4 quarterly sleeves; his market-value floor (USD 150M+) replaced by the 1000 largest (the large-cap focus of this sweep).

SQ16-IND12.name: Industry momentum 12-0 among the 500 largest (top 5 SIC-2 industries by 12-month return, monthly)
SQ16-IND12.rule: Monthly review (every month end with 252 sessions of history). Universe: the 500 largest. Industry = SEC SIC first 2 digits (99, 67 and missing out); industries with 5+ members in the universe. Industry return = market-value-weighted average of members' 12-month return (close / close 252 sessions before - 1, including the last month). Hold every universe member of the 5 industries with the highest return (equal weight); a stock is sold when its industry leaves the top 5 or it leaves the universe.
SQ16-IND12.deviations: SIC 2-digit groups instead of Fama-French 48; members of the 500 largest only; equal weight across held stocks (the paper equal-weights industries).

SQ16-RSNH.name: IBD / Moglen "RS line new high before price" (blue dot) on the 500 largest, hold 63
SQ16-RSNH.rule: Daily at the close of t. Universe: the 500 largest at the prior month end, liquid at t. RS line = close / SPY close. Signal: the RS line closes above its highest value of the previous 251 sessions (240+ present) AND did not on any of the 20 sessions before (fresh) AND the close is NOT above its own highest close of the previous 251 sessions (price not yet at a new high) AND the close is within 15% of that high AND above its 50-session average. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 63; one open trade per stock; no stop.
SQ16-RSNH.deviations: No base / volume pattern check (the discretionary part of the method); fixed 63-session hold (no published exit).
